acceptance.given: The Atomic Obligation coverage graph and its assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime-evidence nodes are assembled for validation.

oracle.expected: The validation artifact reports zero orphan nodes and demonstrates reciprocal participation of every assertion, selector, command, witness, and runtime-evidence node in an Atomic Obligation relation.
forbidden: Any assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence node is disconnected from all Atomic Obligations.
A node exists without reciprocal participation in its required Atomic Obligation coverage relation.
oracle.observable: The conformance validator's coverage-graph result and emitted coverage artifact are inspected during validation.

acceptance.then: Validation accepts the graph only when all covered node types have bidirectional Exact Cover participation and zero orphan nodes.
acceptance.when: Run the Toolchain conformance validation that evaluates the Atomic Obligation coverage graph and inspect its structural coverage result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Bind a negative coverage-graph selector that leaves at least one assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence node without reciprocal Atomic Obligation participation; validation must reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate bidirectional Exact Cover for every Atomic Obligation against assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence, emit an inspectable coverage result, and reject orphan nodes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Validation output remains backward-compatible; rollback restores the prior coverage-graph validation behavior without changing persisted schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: coverage graph assembled -> reciprocal node participation evaluated -> orphan count/result emitted -> validation pass or failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator explicitly reports zero orphan nodes across all five covered node types, or fails with offending node identities when any reciprocal relation is missing.
